in_marathi.name: Kommu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's command
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kommu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kommu is derived from the word 'Kam' meaning desire and 'Kar' meaning do. The name Kommu represents the command or will of Goddess Durga. It symbolizes strength, courage, and determination to fulfill one's desires.
